name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted server for the theme.park CSS themes and skins that restyle more than 50 self-hosted apps such as Sonarr, Radarr, Plex and qBittorrent.

alerts.message: This only serves the stylesheets. To apply a theme, set TP_DOMAIN to this domain in each app's theme.park Docker mod, or point your reverse proxy sub_filter at a file such as https://<domain>/css/base/sonarr/dark.css.
